attempts.text: MATCH (a:Issue)-[r:DEPENDS]->(b:Issue) WHERE coalesce(a.resolutionName,'')='' AND coalesce(b.resolutionName,'')='' RETURN count(r), count(DISTINCT r.outwardLabel), collect(DISTINCT r.outwardLabel)

MATCH p=(a:Issue)-[:DEPENDS*1..5]->(b:Issue) WHERE all(n IN nodes(p) WHERE coalesce(n.resolutionName,'')='') AND size(apoc.coll.toSet(nodes(p)))=size(nodes(p)) AND NOT EXISTS {MATCH (x:Issue)-[:DEPENDS]->(a) WHERE coalesce(x.resolutionName,'')='' AND NOT x IN nodes(p)} AND NOT EXISTS {MATCH (b)-[:DEPENDS]->(y:Issue) WHERE coalesce(y.resolutionName,'')='' AND NOT y IN nodes(p)} RETURN [n IN nodes(p)|n.issueKey] AS path, [r IN relationships(p)|r.linkId] AS links

MATCH p=(a:Issue)-[:DEPENDS*1..5]->(b:Issue) WHERE all(n IN nodes(p) WHERE coalesce(n.resolutionName,'')='') AND NOT EXISTS {MATCH (x:Issue)-[:DEPENDS]->(a) WHERE coalesce(x.resolutionName,'')='' AND NOT x IN nodes(p)} AND NOT EXISTS {MATCH (b)-[:DEPENDS]->(y:Issue) WHERE coalesce(y.resolutionName,'')='' AND NOT y IN nodes(p)} RETURN [n IN nodes(p)|n.issueKey] AS path, [r IN relationships(p)|r.linkId] AS links

MATCH p=(a:Issue)-[:DEPENDS*1..5]->(b:Issue) WHERE all(n IN nodes(p) WHERE coalesce(n.resolutionName,'')='') AND NOT EXISTS {MATCH (x:Issue)-[:DEPENDS]->(a) WHERE coalesce(x.resolutionName,'')='' AND NOT x IN nodes(p)} AND NOT EXISTS {MATCH (b)-[:DEPENDS]->(y:Issue) WHERE coalesce(y.resolutionName,'')='' AND NOT y IN nodes(p)} RETURN [n IN nodes(p)|n.issueKey] AS path, [i IN range(0,size(relationships(p))-1)|[nodes(p)[i].issueKey,nodes(p)[i+1].issueKey]] AS hops, [r IN relationships(p)|[r.linkId]] AS links
